_comments.cr-dotnet-0045: Session State Provider – Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. Set REDIS_CONNECTION_STRING environment variable in ECS task definition or AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Format: <elasticache-endpoint>:<port>,password=<auth-token>,ssl=True,abortConnect=False. SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES env var controls idle timeout (default: 30). InProc HttpSessionState replaced with ASP.NET Core distributed session backed by Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to enable stateless horizontal scaling across multiple ECS tasks or Kubernetes pods.
_comments.cr-dotnet-1034: Async GridView Data Binding with RDS via Entity Framework Core. Set RDS_PROXY_CONNECTION_STRING environment variable in ECS task definition or AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to point at the Amazon RDS Proxy endpoint. Synchronous Web Forms GridView DataBind() patterns replaced with async Task<IActionResult> actions using EF Core connected to Amazon RDS. Prevents thread pool exhaustion under cloud load; enables efficient auto-scaling. Affected controllers: PatientHistoryController (search_patient_DAL_Async), PendingAppointmentController (GetAllpendingappointments_DAL_Async, UpdateAppointment_DAL_Async, Deleteappointment_DAL_Async), PreviousHistoryController (getPHistory_Async).
